mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qs__auth__operation (app_code, operation_code, operation_name, operation_desc, resource_type, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{appCode}, #{operationCode}, #{operationName}, #{operationDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{resourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.update:
UPDATE qs__auth__operation
operation_code = #{operationCode.value,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
operation_name = #{operationName.value,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
operation_desc = #{operationDesc.value,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
resource_type = #{resourceType.value,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
updated_by = #{updatedBy,jdbcType=BIGINT},
WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
